verdict.rationale: Avalara's ECM/CertCapture product explicitly collects, validates, and stores exemption/resale certificates, and AvaTax calculation engine references exemption logic at calc time, indicating integration exists. However, evidence does not detail expiry tracking, renewal workflows, or the precise automatic application mechanism linking ECM records to AvaTax calculation in real time. missing for 10: documentation of expiry/renewal tracking, explicit description of automatic application at calculation time, and independent/hands-on confirmation of end-to-end flow.
